# Specimen procedure API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Something done to a specimen set, such as sectioning, staining or clearing.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/specimenprocedure/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `specimenprocedure` (detail, create, update), `specimenprocedures` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `specimen_set` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [SpecimenProcedure type](/api/schemas/specimenprocedure/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`materialusage`](/api/modules/materialusage/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [SpecimenProcedure types](/api/schemas/specimenprocedure/) **[required]** |
| `status` | one of `planned`, `performed`, `cancelled` **[required]**. Planned: prepared but nothing has happened yet. Performed: this record describes what was done. Cancelled: planned and then dropped; kept for the record. |
| `target_scope` | one of `whole_set`, `specific` **[required]**. Whether this procedure applies to the whole specimen set or specific specimens only. |
| `specimen_set` | [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `target_specimens` | list of [`specimen`](/api/stem/specimen/) ids; nestable. Individual specimens targeted by this procedure. Leave empty when the procedure applies to the whole specimen set. |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `date_time` | datetime; nullable |
| `target_regions` | list of [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/) ids |
| `equipment` | list of [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/) ids |
| `protocol` | [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) id; nullable |
| `licenses` | list of [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) ids |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]**. Schema version for type_json field |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |
| `materials` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `stages` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('specimenprocedure', load_all=True)
records = resp['specimenprocedures']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('specimenprocedure', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.specimenprocedures;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimenprocedure', data={"type": "AntigenRetrieval", "status": "performed", "target_scope": "whole_set", "specimen_set": "<specimenset-id>", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}})
record = resp.json()['specimenprocedure']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'AntigenRetrieval', 'status', 'performed', 'target_scope', 'whole_set', 'specimen_set', '<specimenset-id>', 'details', struct()), 'specimenprocedure');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.specimenprocedure;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimenprocedure', id='<id>', data={"notes": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'notes', 'new value'), 'specimenprocedure', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('specimenprocedure', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'specimenprocedure');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `apply_material_template` | POST `/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/<id>/apply-material-template/` |
| `material_options` | GET `/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/material-options/` |
| `materials` | GET, PUT `/api/private/modules/specimenprocedure/<id>/materials/` |

`materials` returns the ordered material usage rows of the specimen procedure; `PUT` replaces them as a whole. `apply-material-template` copies the rows of a material usage template. `material-options` lists the material roles and allowed sources of a type (`?type=<Type>`).

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Specimen procedure data model page](/datamodel/modules/specimenprocedure/).
